ideas.instructions: Have the stuffed animal gently peek the sleeping doll out from its blanket, then tuck it back in.
ideas.title: Quick peekaboo

ideas.instructions: Pretend the stuffed animal is taking the sleeping doll on a quiet adventure; describe places they visit and how they keep the doll cozy.
ideas.title: Cozy journey

ideas.instructions: Take turns being the stuffed animal and the doll. Make up a short bedtime story, with the stuffed animal caring for its sleepy friend.
ideas.title: Bedtime story
